en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a canal in a historic European city with brick gabled houses on both sides and a tall belfry tower rising in the background. A small bridge with railings crosses the canal in the foreground. On the right is a stepped‑gable building with signage on its facade, and a small square with people and market stalls can be seen. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the card.
